trap.label: so/such
trap.wrong: It was so a hard thing.
trap.right: It was such a hard thing.
trap.why: Português usa “tão” para tudo; so não aceita substantivo sem adjetivo + a.

fix.wrong: I was so busy what I forgot.
fix.right: I was so busy that I forgot.

fix.wrong: It’s worth to take a break.
It was so a hard thing.
fix.right: It was such a hard thing.

rewrite.prompt: Una: “I was busy. I forgot.” (so… that)
rewrite.answer: I was so busy that I forgot.

rewrite.prompt: Una: “It was a hard thing. I cried.” (such a… that)
rewrite.answer: It was such a hard thing that I cried.
